status: FREEZE READINESS OPEN — C1 DENOMINATOR FRAGILITY

representativeness.estimand: representative eligible pre-37 cycle-membership directed-edge population
representativeness.selector: outcome-blind hash order over all eligible edges; U is not a ranking input
representativeness.consequence: A1 tests a representative eligible-edge effect. It does not test an effect among high-propensity or anomalous edges; that would require a different selector and a new target set before freeze.

freeze_readiness.reason: Four target rows make the precommitted 0.95 C1 floor a 100% rule (3/4 = 0.75). C4 non-target rows are instrumented and, with the target rows, would give 63-64 planned rows per seed (3 allowed losses), but no cell has run, so C4 and the actual C1 denominator are unmeasured.
to_pass: Run the planned cells with the C4 neighbour stream.
Attach paired neighbour deltas and score C1/C4.
Show C1 at or above 0.95 with a denominator larger than four (the planned C1 denominator is 63-64 per seed) and C4 at or below 0.05.

freeze_decision.worth_freezing: NO — HOLD AS DRAFT UNTIL C1/C4 ARE MEASURED
freeze_decision.worth_freezing_reason: The target sets are compliant and representative, but no cell has run with the new C4 neighbour stream, so the C1 and C4 denominators remain unmeasured. Do not regenerate targets unless Path B is chosen.
freeze_decision.scope: the current six-seed target artifact and the current four-target A1 cell output
basis: The C6 prevalence proxy is adequate: 602/672 K and 586/672 Y_ind.

The C1 denominator is four target rows, so the 0.95 floor is a 100% rule (3/4 = 0.75); C4 would add 59-60 planned non-target rows per seed, bringing the planned C1 denominator to 63-64, but none has been observed.
All six seeds having all four K rows is 6.9% under independence; the design is fragile, not merely underpowered.
revisit_when: The planned cells run with the C4 neighbour stream and C1/C4 are scored.
A larger target block or a redesigned selector is registered before freeze.

findings.finding: The 24 targets are statistically indistinguishable from the 358 unselected candidates on cycle-36 strength.
Cycle membership and positive U do not narrow the candidate universe; every candidate is eligible.
C6 supplies a high K/Y_ind denominator in its own world; this is a proxy, not target validation.
With four target rows, the 0.95 C1 floor is effectively 100% preservation; one lost row gives 0.75.
C4 plus the four target rows would raise the planned C1 denominator from four to 63-64 rows per seed, allowing 3 losses at 0.95; the observed denominator is still unmeasured.

evidence.status: UNMEASURED — no A1 cell has run
evidence.baseline_caveat: C1 counts only edges available in the paired A+K+ control, so the observed denominator will be at most 63-64.

findings.finding: A0's hard-edge prevalence is low, but a random 24-target sample has a material chance of containing one.

decision.verdict: FREEZE READINESS OPEN — C1 DENOMINATOR FRAGILITY
decision.reading: P0 and feasibility pass, but four target rows per seed make the precommitted 0.95 C1 floor a 100% preservation rule. The prevalence proxy is adequate; the denominator is not. C4 non-target rows are implemented and, with the four target rows, would raise the planned denominator to 63-64 per seed, allowing 3 losses, but no cell has run. C1 remains unmeasured; do not freeze on the current target artifact.

freeze_question.question: Does a random eligible-edge design have enough expected measurable structure to justify freeze?
freeze_question.basis: K and Y_ind prevalence are high enough that missing structure is not the blocker. The blocker is C1: four rows make the 0.95 floor a 100% rule, and the all-six all-four-K proxy is 6.9% under independence. C4 rows plus targets would raise the planned denominator to 63-64 per seed, but no cell has run, so the observed denominator is still unmeasured.
freeze_question.if_yes: Freeze the representative eligible-edge design after the manifest review.
freeze_question.if_no: Do not freeze; enlarge the C1 denominator with C4 rows or redesign the target block.

next: If Path A (representative eligible-edge effect) is retained: run the planned cells with the C4 neighbour stream and score C1/C4.
If Path B (high-carrier-propensity effect) is required: redesign the selector and regenerate targets before freeze; that is a different experiment.
Re-run this review after C1/C4 are measured; do not freeze before that.

not_evidence: A read-only power/prevalence review over different-seed C6 and A0 records. Its C1 expansion is a planned count from the A1 candidate counts, not an observed denominator. It runs no A1 cell, assigns no seed, freezes no target and establishes no causal, capability or transfer claim.
